desc:
🪽 MUSHOKU UNBOUND: LIFE RPG ✨

You died. Now you're reborn in a world of swords and magic, and every year of your new life is yours to shape.

Roll your trait, master spells, train your power and choose your path. Save your family or abandon fate. Become a hero, a legend... or a villain.

🌟 FEATURES
🔮 Roll traits from Common to GODLY (Sword Saint, Dragon God & more)
📜 11 branching story Paths: good, evil or chaotic
⚡ Chant incantations in combat to power up your spells
✨ NEW: Spell Creation, invent your own magic
⚔️ Take on Raids for rare spell materials
🌳 Path Tree: see every choice and rewind your fate
👥 Character slots: live more than one life

Inspired by Mushoku Tensei. Story through Season 2!

🎁 Join the group for a FREE portrait frame + codes
💬 New codes in our community server
